messages:
emma_marketing: Quick sync — final run-of-show for the May 5 webinar. Need signoff on three things before we lock: (1) registration page copy + required fields, (2) Zoom settings + recording handoff, (3) post-event email + lead routing. I pasted a compact checklist below.

raj_ops: On it. Posted the Zoom link draft in the doc. Can we confirm cloud recording + transcript ON? Also want a backup local recording on the host laptop.

lucy_content: Reg page copy is in the google doc -> https://docs.google.com/example. Short headline, 2 bullets, CTA = "Reserve my seat". Ask for company + job title as optional fields only. No extra gating.

matt_media: For recordings: set Zoom to record to cloud (separate audio file for panelists), enable auto-transcript (CC). After event I'll pull cloudMP4 + transcript.srt and run our clip-split script.

emma_marketing: Perfect. Sophie, can you confirm HubSpot mapping for registrant -> lead + tag? We want utm_source=webinar, utm_campaign=scalebench_may5. Also add "webinar:may5" tag.

sophie_growth: Yep. I updated the workflow: new registrant -> create contact if not exists -> add tag "webinar:may5" -> assign to AE queue 'inbound-webinars'. Also add property "attended:true/false" based on Zoom attendance webhook.

raj_ops: Zoom settings I'll paste here for clarity. Please review and 👍 if ok: 
```
Settings: 
- Auto-record: Cloud (Host)
- Separate audio files: ON
- Enable cloud transcript: ON
- Allow participants to unmute: OFF (panelists allowed)
- Waiting room: OFF (we're using passcode)
- Passcode: autogenerated via calendar link
- Alternative host: matt_media, lucy_content
```

lucy_content: Looks good. One note: enable "Save chat" so we capture Q&A. We'll review chat for followup questions.

matt_media: After event I'll use this pipeline: download cloud MP4 + transcript -> run `scripts/srt-split --by-speaker` -> upload clips to GDrive /Marketing/Events/ScaleBench_May5 -> tag clips in notion. I'll add a sample command in the repo.

emma_marketing: Post-event emails: 1) Day 0 (thank you + recording link) 2) Day 2 (highlights + CTA) 3) Day 7 (case study invite). Sophie, can you draft copy for Day 0 and Day 2? Keep Day 0 short: recording + TL;DR bullets + CTA to demo.

sophie_growth: Drafts done. Putting them in the marketing folder. Also adding UTM'd recording link -> our CDN path.

raj_ops: One ops detail: Zoom cloud retention is 90 days. We will export SRTs and MP4s to GDrive right after the event. OpsBot will post when uploads complete.

opsbot: [automation] Upload monitor active. Will watch Zoom cloud folder `redwood-webinars/scalebench_may5` and post status to this thread when files appear.

lucy_content: Rehearsal tomorrow at 11am PT. Please join 10 mins early. We'll run mic checks + screen share.

emma_marketing: Final asks before I lock the page: 
- confirm optional fields on reg page (company, title) -> lucy ✅
- zoom settings confirmed -> raj ✅
- HubSpot flow + tags confirmed -> sophie ✅
- media pipeline + upload -> matt ✅

emma_marketing: Ok locking everything now. If anything changes, update this thread. Thanks team! :tada:
